name: diag_look_census_submissions_01
command:
import pathlib,json,re,importlib.util,datetime
r=pathlib.Path.cwd(); plan=json.loads((r/'logs/review/diag_look_census_plan_01/census_plan.json').read_text()); jobs=[]
for group in plan['groups']:
 f,=list((r/'logs/pbs').glob(group['outer_name']+'-*'));p=json.loads((f/'payload.json').read_text());s=json.loads((f/'submission.json').read_text())
 assert s['returncode']==0
 job,=re.findall(r'\b\d+\.hopper-m-\d+\b',s['stdout'])
 assert p['requested_gpu_count']==1 and p['requested_host'] is None and p['queue']=='autox' and p['budget_group']=='T01v2'
 assert p['requested_wall_seconds']==group['wall_seconds']
 jobs.append({'job':job,'name':group['outer_name'],'inner':group['inner_name'],'receipt':str(f.relative_to(r)),'requested_wall_seconds':p['requested_wall_seconds'],'pair_ids':group['pair_ids']})
m=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase',r/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py');phase=importlib.util.module_from_spec(m);m.loader.exec_module(phase);b=phase.budget_state(r)
assert b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['T01v2']<=16 and b['accounted_or_reserved_total']<=60
note='\n### Look D4 diagnostic census submitted after VPN restoration\n\n'
note+='VPN connectivity restored; queued/running PBS jobs were not signalled. The previously pushed fixed plan (02196e0) covers 17 unique current-standard independently constructed LookFlip pairs: one authentic original rejection reused plus 7/6/3 new diagnostic exports. Three no-host, oneGPU Express/autox submissions: '+json.dumps(jobs,sort_keys=True)+'. Combined requested ceiling 1.7666666666666666 chargedGPUh. Ordinary table rejections remain rejections; black/timeout/error/unstarted outcomes remain explicit; no cache/training permission or rule change.\n\n'
note+='Accounted-or-reserved chargedGPUh: '+json.dumps(b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],sort_keys=True)+'; shared '+str(b['accounted_or_reserved_total'])+'/60 (queued/running jobs use requested ceilings). Full-view outcomes pending.\n'
with (r/'STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write(note)
print('CENSUS_SUBMISSIONS: '+json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'jobs':jobs,'budget':b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],'total':b['accounted_or_reserved_total']},sort_keys=True))
